operations.name: post_ai_runs
operations.summary: Create and execute an AI run with routing and streaming
operations.description: Creates one run and streams run_started (with run_id), provider-dependent progress/router/fallback/chunk events, then done or failed. Every frame has an opaque replay ID. Reconnect via GET /ai/runs/{run_id}/events rather than repeating this POST. Disconnecting does not cancel execution; terminal events follow persisted status.

errors.description: No local runner or configured cloud provider available, or stream limit reached

operations.name: get_ai_runs_run_id_events
operations.description: Replays bounded retained run events with absolute event IDs; done or failed closes the stream. Missing in-memory history can recover persisted terminal status. An expired or foreign cursor emits resync_required; fetch the run before reconnecting. A reconnect after the stream's last event is answered with 204, the event-stream standard's signal to stop reconnecting.

success_responses.description: The run has finished and Last-Event-ID is past its last event: stop reconnecting

parameters.name: last_event_id
parameters.description: Opaque SSE event ID; unavailable history emits resync_required and closes.

errors.description: Observer unavailable or stream limit reached

operations.name: get_ai_runner_pull_job_id_events
operations.description: Streams the job's progress snapshot whenever it changes; completed or failed closes the stream. A reconnect receives the current snapshot, and once the pull has finished it is answered with 204, the event-stream standard's signal to stop reconnecting. Disconnecting does not cancel the pull.

success_responses.description: The pull has finished: stop reconnecting

parameters.name: last_event_id
parameters.description: Opaque SSE event ID, sent by a reconnecting client.
